hook: The word chintz, for floral fabric, comes from Hindi.

views.definition: Platform-reported cumulative views; platform definitions differ.

average_watch_time_seconds.definition: Platform-reported average watch duration in seconds.
average_watch_time_seconds.reason: facebook per-media metric not collected by this exporter; requires a supported Insights metric and account permissions. No account-level substitute used.

three_second_retention.definition: Platform-reported fraction reaching three seconds; unavailable without a supported retention endpoint.
three_second_retention.reason: facebook per-media metric not collected by this exporter; requires a supported Insights metric and account permissions. No account-level substitute used.

completion_rate.definition: Platform-reported completed plays divided by eligible plays; not average view percentage.
completion_rate.reason: facebook per-media metric not collected by this exporter; requires a supported Insights metric and account permissions. No account-level substitute used.

shares.reason: facebook per-media metric not collected by this exporter; requires a supported Insights metric and account permissions. No account-level substitute used.

followers_gained.definition: YouTube subscribers gained attributed to this video; Meta per-media follows if available.
followers_gained.reason: Not returned by this export or unavailable for this media/account.

shares_per_1000_views.reason: Requires numerator and positive views from a compatible report period.

followers_per_1000_views.reason: Requires numerator and positive views from a compatible report period.
